name: TJGC Group Limited
summary: TJGC Group Ltd. functions as a holding company, primarily dedicated to delivering comprehensive marketing and advertising solutions. The firm furnishes its clients with end-to-end advertising support, managing the entire lifecycle of an advertising campaign from strategic conceptualization and creative development through to its launch, ongoing administration, and subsequent performance evaluation. This enterprise was established on May 13, 2022, by co-founders Kai Kwan Lam, Chi Fung Lau, and Chun Pong Siu, and its corporate headquarters are located in Hong Kong.
